caption: : Avg. performance across 11 datasets (y-axis) consistently improves as the number of training examples increases (x-axis). Max is 29k examples, the full size of our dataset.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between the number of training datasets and average performance. The x-axis is labeled "# of training dataset (k)" with a linear scale, ranging from 5 to 30 in intervals of 5, representing the number of training datasets in thousands. The y-axis is labeled "Average Performance" with a linear scale, ranging from 48 to 56 in intervals of 2. A single black line with circular markers and a solid style is plotted, showing a steady increase in average performance as the number of training datasets increases from 5k to 30k, starting at approximately 48 at 5k and rising to around 56 at 30k.
